strings.notes: 小瞳 not in 0719; US contact Jamie (US 0677)

strings.zh: 你可真是强啊,{NEWLINE}我们下次再来对战吧！{SCROLL}能经常和你这样的{NEWLINE}训练师战斗{CLEAR}我想一定能让我更强的！{SCROLL}所以⋯⋯{NEWLINE}可以的话能告诉我{CLEAR}你的电话号码吗？{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: You’re very good at battling.{NEWLINE}We should battle again sometime.{SCROLL}By challenging a tough Trainer like you,{NEWLINE}I think I can get better, too.{SCROLL}So how about it?{NEWLINE}Would you give me your{CLEAR}phone number? {VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 是吗,真是遗憾⋯⋯{NEWLINE}改变主意了的话再来找我吧。
strings.en: That’s too bad...{NEWLINE}Let me know if you change your mind.

strings.zh: 能经常和你这样的{NEWLINE}训练师战斗{CLEAR}我想一定能让我更强的！{SCROLL}所以⋯⋯可以的话{NEWLINE}能告诉我你的电话号码吗？{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: By challenging a tough Trainer like you,{NEWLINE}I think I can get better, too.{SCROLL}So how about it? Would you give me{NEWLINE}your phone number? {VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 哎呀？我说⋯⋯{NEWLINE}你不就在附近吗？{SCROLL}干嘛不到我{NEWLINE}旁边来直接找我说话呢？
strings.en: Huh? You... Aren’t you nearby?{SCROLL}Why not come here and just{NEWLINE}talk to me face-to-face?

strings.zh: 你还记得我的{NEWLINE}{VAR:0100:10}吗？{SCROLL}我的{VAR:0100:10}{NEWLINE}跑起来非常快的！{SCROLL}坐在它背上{NEWLINE}非常爽！{SCROLL}再见啦！
strings.en: Do you remember my{NEWLINE}sweet {VAR:0100:10}?{SCROLL}{VAR:0100:10} runs very fast.{SCROLL}It’s exhilarating to ride on its{NEWLINE}back when it really gets going.{SCROLL}Bye-bye!

strings.zh: 你见过{NEWLINE}{VAR:0100:11}吗？{SCROLL}不久前我和它打过⋯⋯{NEWLINE}它比我想的还要快,{CLEAR}吓了我一跳。{CLEAR}当然最后是我赢了！{SCROLL}再见！
strings.en: Oh, have you ever seen{NEWLINE}a {VAR:0100:11} before?{SCROLL}I just battled one... It was{NEWLINE}much faster than I expected.{SCROLL}I was a little shocked.{NEWLINE}I still won, of course.{SCROLL}Bye-bye!

strings.zh: 前几天我发现了{VAR:0100:11},{NEWLINE}本来想抓它的⋯⋯{CLEAR}结果没精灵球了。{SCROLL}平时不注意检查背包,{NEWLINE}到关键时刻{CLEAR}就要悲剧了。{CLEAR}你也要注意啊！{SCROLL}再见！
strings.en: Oh, I just saw a wild {VAR:0100:11}.{NEWLINE}I was trying to catch it when I{CLEAR}noticed that I was all out of{CLEAR}Poké Balls.{SCROLL}If you don’t check your items, you{NEWLINE}may run out at the worst time.{CLEAR}I hope you learn from my mistake.{SCROLL}Bye-bye!

strings.zh: 我说,在来一场对战吧？{NEWLINE}这次我一定能赢的！{SCROLL}我现在在{VAR:0104:3},{NEWLINE}你到了之后来找我吧！
strings.en: Do you want to battle? I’m going to win{NEWLINE}this time!{SCROLL}I’ll be waiting for you around{NEWLINE}{VAR:0104:3}. Look for me, OK?

strings.zh: 哎？{NEWLINE}{VAR:0103:0},怎么了？{CLEAR}不会是忘了吧？{SCROLL}我在{VAR:0104:3}等你！
strings.en: Um... {VAR:0103:0}? What’s wrong?{NEWLINE}Did you forget our deal?{SCROLL}{VAR:0104:3}.{NEWLINE}That’s where I’m waiting.

strings.zh: 哎？{NEWLINE}{VAR:0103:0},怎么了？{CLEAR}不会是忘了吧？{SCROLL}我在{VAR:0104:3}等你！
strings.en: Um... {VAR:0103:0}? What’s wrong?{NEWLINE}Did you forget our deal?{SCROLL}{VAR:0104:3}.{NEWLINE}That’s where I’m waiting.
